title: Recursive Cauchy–Schwarz bound
statement: For a family $F$ indexed by the $r$-dimensional cube with values in real-valued functions on $\mathbb F_2^n$, define a real quantity recursively. At $r=0$, it is the diagonal Gowers inner average of the function assigned to the unique point of the zero-dimensional cube. At $r+1$, it is the product of the square roots of the quantities at level $r$ obtained by appending, respectively, the bit $0$ and the bit $1$ to each $r$-dimensional input.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is the dimension parameter, with the stated recursion covering $r=0$ and $r+1$
$F$ is a family indexed by the $r$-dimensional cube, with values in real-valued functions on $\mathbb F_2^n$
